entry.name: HT-Bench
entry.title: HT-Bench: Benchmarking and Learning Dexterous Full-Hand Tactile Representations with Egocentric Vision
entry.summary: Benchmark of egocentric RGB paired with full-hand tactile maps, about 10M RGB and 7.8M tactile frames over 226 tasks, built from OpenTouch and EgoTouch (TouchAnything) plus newly collected full-hand tactile sequences whose glove is not named, with four evaluation tasks (tactile retrieval, masked inpainting, vision-to-tactile synthesis, tactile frame prediction).

sensor.note: Tactile frames are used as 1x224x224 normalised full-hand maps; the device of the new sequences is not named.

scale.text: About 10M RGB frames and 7.8M tactile frames over 226 tasks; one task held out as OOD, the rest split 9:1; hours, subjects and the share of new data not stated

entry.access: The paper states 'We will release all data, evaluation protocols, pretrained weights, and training/testing scripts.'; no link is given (checked 2026-11-25).
caveats: Part of HT-Bench is existing OpenTouch and EgoTouch data; how many frames are new is not stated.
The glove or sensor of the newly collected sequences is not named, so taxel count, rate and coverage are unknown.
The paper reports some figures inconsistently between the abstract, Section 5.1 and Table 2.
sources: https://arxiv.org/html/2606.19161 (data sources, frame counts, scenes, splits, release sentence)
unconfirmed: coverage tip/phalanx/palm follows the paper's 'full-hand' wording; the new device's layout is not described.
Camera mount 'head' is assumed from 'egocentric'; the camera model is not named.
scene_types map the paper's list (home, electronics workbench, chemistry lab, retail, workbench, outdoor) onto catalog labels.
frames is the tactile frame count (7.8M); RGB frames are about 10M.
